bio.text: Joe Alfieri is a Republican who represents District 4 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a second term; the directory lists Alfieri as retired.

The legislature's biography describes Alfieri as an entrepreneur and businessman who opened the first retail computer store in New York City in 1980 and later started an advertising agency in California.
It says Alfieri moved to Coeur d'Alene, where Alfieri worked as a business developer and was involved in the chamber of commerce and a founding board member of Shakespeare CDA.
